scope: Local APIC closing slice: spurious acknowledge path, LVT Timer mask semantics, reset matrix, priority/EOI and erroneous-access atomicity
source: Intel 64 and IA-32 SDM release 093, Volume 3A Chapter 13 (§13.9 spurious interrupt, LVT, PPR/EOI)
limitations: only the Timer LVT exists; CMCI, Thermal, Perf, LINT0/1, Error, Version and ESR are unsupported (UnknownOffset)
spurious acknowledge is a device-state operation; CPU delivery still ends a changed selection with InterruptSelectionChanged
x2APIC, multi-CPU startup, NMI sources, IOAPIC S4-26c, IDT/IF, HLT wakeup, JIT and Linux acceptance are out of scope
